title: SPA / client-side
summary: DOM XSS from the URL, postMessage, browser storage, client-only authorization, secrets in the bundle, CORS, and client redirects.

groups.title: DOM sinks
groups.summary: location, postMessage, and storage into HTML / eval / navigation.

checks.title: DOM XSS from the URL
checks.why: hash, search, or a path segment is written into innerHTML, eval, or a javascript: URL.
checks.validate: A marker in the URL executes in the real app shell.

variants.name: Hash to HTML
variants.expect: Grep the bundle for location.hash, location.search, document.write, innerHTML, insertAdjacentHTML.

variants.name: javascript: navigation
variants.expect: Must not become location.href / window.open. data:text/html,… is the same class.

variants.name: Template sink
variants.expect: Client-side template injection (Angular/Vue/Mavo gadgets) after you confirm the sink.

checks.title: postMessage origin checks
checks.why: The app listens for message and trusts event.data without checking event.origin.
checks.validate: A page you control can drive a sink or an authenticated action.

variants.name: Listener inventory
variants.expect: For each listener, record whether origin is compared to an exact allowlist (===, not indexOf).

variants.name: Drive from a child window
variants.expect: Must be ignored. A token or HTML sink accepting this is the finding. Use a test account.

checks.title: Browser storage as input and secret store
checks.why: A JWT or role in localStorage is writable, and a stored value later hits a sink.
checks.validate: Writing a marker into storage and reloading either escalates privilege or executes script.

variants.name: Token / role in localStorage
variants.expect: Reload. Client-only role changes are presentational if the API refuses; a working admin view against a member API is still a finding if it discloses data.

variants.name: Storage → sink
variants.payload: localStorage.setItem('name','') then reload / navigate.
variants.expect: If name is dropped into innerHTML, that is DOM XSS. Treat storage as untrusted input.

groups.title: Trust and origin
groups.summary: The bundle is public. The API is the control.

checks.title: Client-only authorization
checks.why: Routes and buttons are hidden in the SPA but the API still answers.
checks.validate: A member token on an admin API route succeeds. The hidden button is not the finding.

variants.name: Call the hidden route
variants.payload:
GET /api/v1/admin/users HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <member-token>
variants.expect: 403/404. Repeat any path you grepped from the bundle (admin, internal, debug, impersonate).

variants.name: Feature-flag in localStorage
variants.expect: If the UI appears but the API refuses, record as informational. If the API obeys the flag, that is the finding.

checks.title: Secrets in the JavaScript bundle
checks.why: The published bundle contains a live privileged secret, not a public site key.
checks.validate: A retrieved value authenticates as a privileged identity or signs a privileged request.

variants.name: Grep the bundle
variants.expect: Confirm any hit is a live credential, not a public Stripe pk_ or a Mapbox token.

variants.name: Source map
variants.payload:
GET /assets/index-*.js.map HTTP/1.1
Host: www.example.com
Connection: close
variants.expect: A map with sourcesContent is a lead. Embedded secrets or internal URLs are the finding.

checks.title: CORS on the API origin
checks.why: A reflected ACAO plus credentials lets another origin read the API with the victim's cookies.
checks.validate: A controlled origin can read a non-public body with credentials.

variants.name: Reflected Origin with cookies
variants.payload:
GET /api/v1/me HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Origin: https://evil.example
Cookie: session=<account-A>
variants.expect: ACAO: https://evil.example and ACAC: true together are the finding if the body is the user.

variants.name: null / regex mistakes
variants.payload:
GET /api/v1/me HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Origin: https://www.example.com.evil.example
Cookie: session=<account-A>
variants.expect: Substring and endsWith('example.com') allowlists fail this way. Also try Origin: null.

checks.title: Client-side open redirect
checks.why: next=, return=, or a router push accepts an absolute or javascript: URL.
checks.validate: The SPA navigates off-origin or into a javascript: URL.

variants.name: Absolute next
variants.expect: After login the shell must stay on-origin. Watch location.assign / href / router.push.

variants.name: javascript: next
variants.expect: Must be rejected. This is XSS, not just a redirect.
